summary: 光线塑形解谜，2026 年 9 月 23 日上架，PawPaw Games 开发并发行，分类为休闲／独立／策略。商店 AI 披露列出两项 AI 协助内容：部分语言的商店页本地化与部分语言的游戏内文本本地化。本站据此把翻译登记为已使用，其余七个领域因披露没有点名而登记为未说明，不能据此认定未使用。第三方站 gameaicheck.com 在转录后自加的评价（称游戏本体看起来是人工制作）属该站判断，本站不采纳。所有结论只有开发者自述支撑，未经独立审计。
reviewNote: 核查英文商店页完整 AI 披露栏（两项列表原文）、身份（开发与发行均为 PawPaw Games，正式版）与英文讨论区（首页可见 8 个主题、总数 8，即整个分区都已覆盖），没有任何 AI 相关主题。公开报道单独检索 1 次（原始响应存档 press-search.json，6 条结果），登记并读取 1 条来源：gameaicheck.com 的本作条目页，其对两项披露的转录与商店原文一致，页面自带的 AI 程度评级与“看起来人工制作”的说法属第三方自动判断，本站不采纳。其余结果里两条是试玩版页面、一条是商店页（已有官方取证），一条 YouTube 视频与一个 Bluesky 账号页无法经抓取中转读取正文，按规则不登记。未检索到独立媒体报道本作的 AI 使用，这不能证明未使用。
description: 你是一盏会发光的小灯，走进一座植物远比长相危险的花园：贪吃植物朝光生长、窃贼植物避光退开、隐身灌木能把光藏起来，你要用光线改变它们的走向来开路解谜，在一到两小时的流程里往花园深处找回你的小狗。

english.summary: A light-shaping puzzle adventure released on Sep 23, 2026, developed and published by PawPaw Games and filed under Casual, Indie and Strategy, where the player is a tiny lamp guiding plants that grow toward light, recoil from it or can hide it. The Steam AI disclosure lists two uses: AI tools assisted the store page localisation and the in-game text localisation for some languages. This site records translation as used with the some languages limit kept, and the other seven areas as not addressed because the disclosure never names them. The claim on the gameaicheck.com entry page that the game itself appears human-made is that aggregator judgement rather than a developer statement and is not adopted. Every finding rests on the developer own statement and none of it has been independently audited.
english.reviewNote: Checked the complete English Steam AI disclosure block with both list items, the identity (PawPaw Games as both developer and publisher, a full release rather than a demo) and the English discussion area, whose homepage shows 8 visible topics out of 8, meaning the whole board was covered with no AI topic in it. One dedicated web search was run, archived as press-search.json, all 6 results dispositioned and one source registered and read in full, the gameaicheck.com entry page for this game, whose transcription of the two localisation items matches the store text; the AI extent rating and the appears human-made remark on that page are its own machine judgement and are not adopted. Two other results were demo pages, one was the Steam store page already covered by the official evidence, and the YouTube video and the Bluesky profile could not be read through the GitHub Actions relay, so neither is registered. No independent press report about this game AI use was found, which does not prove anything about non-use.
